verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers source-code access, C++/Blueprint/Python scripting, plugins, replication, and remote control APIs, but nothing addresses exporting a user's project/assets from Unreal's proprietary formats (.uasset, .uproject) into open, portable formats for migration away from the engine. Source code access (unreal-docs-10/18/21) is about engine internals, not user data portability.
